title: Shilpa Medicare Receives USFDA Establishment Inspection Report with VAI Classification for Hyderabad Unit
summary: Hyderabad: Shilpa Medicare Limited has received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) with a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI)...

contentHtml:
Hyderabad: Shilpa Medicare Limited has received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) with a Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification for its Unit VII, Analytical Services Division, in Hyderabad, Telangana. With the issuance of the EIR, the surveillance inspection conducted at the facility has been formally closed.

The USFDA inspection was conducted from September 16 to September 18, 2026, at Unit VII of the company's Analytical Services Division in Hyderabad. The facility underwent a surveillance inspection, following which the regulatory authority issued the EIR with a VAI classification.

The company had previously intimated the stock exchanges about the inspection on September 18, 2026. The latest communication, dated November 26, 2026, confirms receipt of the EIR and closure of the inspection.

A Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classification means that objectionable conditions were identified during the inspection, but the regulatory authority has determined that voluntary corrective actions are appropriate. The company is expected to address the observations and maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Shilpa Medicare Limited stated that it remains committed to maintaining high standards of quality and regulatory compliance, with continued emphasis on strengthening and improving its quality systems.

Shilpa Medicare is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceutical products, including active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and formulations. Its operations include research, development and manufacturing activities serving domestic and international markets.
